hook.en: Courts are the last step. Responsible businesses, trade associations, alert consumers, NGOs and the government all protect consumers long before a case is filed.
hook.kn: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಕೊನೆಯ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ. ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳು, ಜಾಗೃತ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು, ಸರ್ಕಾರೇತರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಮೊದಲೇ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: List the ways and means of consumer protection
Explain the role of consumer organisations and NGOs

narration.en: Courts are the last step. Responsible businesses, trade associations, alert consumers, NGOs and the government all protect consumers long before a case is filed.
narration.kn: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಕೊನೆಯ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ. ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯುತ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳು, ಜಾಗೃತ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು, ಸರ್ಕಾರೇತರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಮೊದಲೇ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Consumer protection is achieved through: self-regulation by business (ethical standards, grievance cells); business associations such as FICCI and CII laying down codes of conduct; consumer awareness; consumer organisations; and government, through laws such as the Consumer Protection Act 2019, the Indian Contract Act 1872, the Sale of Goods Act 1930, the Essential Commodities Act 1955, the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, the Trade Marks Act 1999 and the Competition Act 2002.
body.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸ್ವನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳು, ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಜಾಗೃತಿ, ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಕಾನೂನುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ.

narration.en: Consumer protection is achieved through: self-regulation by business (ethical standards, grievance cells); business associations such as FICCI and CII laying down codes of conduct; consumer awareness; consumer organisations; and government, through laws such as the Consumer Protection Act 2019, the Indian Contract Act 1872, the Sale of Goods Act 1930, the Essential Commodities Act 1955, the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, the Trade Marks Act 1999 and the Competition Act 2002.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸ್ವನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ, ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಘಗಳು, ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಜಾಗೃತಿ, ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಕಾನೂನುಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಸಂರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ.

caption.en: Consumer organisations and NGOs educate consumers, test products and file cases on their behalf. Spread their effort and see awareness, complaints filed and cases won change in a town of 10,000 consumers.
caption.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಪರವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಕರಣ ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಹಂಚಿ 10,000 ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ನೋಡಿ.

title.en: On the board: Ways of consumer protection

narration.en: Consumers are protected from five directions.

say.en: Consumers are protected from five directions.
Business associations like FICCI and CII lay down codes; government passes laws like the 2019 Act.
Consumer organisations educate, test products, give legal help and file complaints for consumers.

narration.en: Sort each action by the way of consumer protection it represents.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಯಾವ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

prompt.en: Sort each action by the way of consumer protection it represents.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಯ ಯಾವ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: Consumers are protected by business itself, business associations, consumer awareness and organisations, and government laws.

text.en: A company sets up its own grievance cell
A firm adopts a code of fair pricing on its own
FICCI lays down a code of conduct for its members
CII asks members to deal fairly with customers
The Bureau of Indian Standards certifies products
A consumer group tests products in a lab and publishes results
An NGO files a complaint on behalf of many consumers

title.en: Role of consumer organisations and NGOs

body.en: Consumer organisations and NGOs educate the public about their rights through training and workshops, publish periodicals and other material, test products in laboratories and publish results, encourage consumers to protest against exploitation, give legal assistance, file complaints in consumer commissions on behalf of consumers, and take the initiative in filing cases in the interest of the general public.
body.kn: ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ, ನಿಯತಕಾಲಿಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವು ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ಪರವಾಗಿ ದೂರು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: A registered consumer society in Hassan tests five brands of bottled water in a lab, publishes the results in its magazine and files a complaint against one brand that failed. Identify the roles played.

steps.en: Lab testing of products and publishing the results.
Publishing periodicals to educate the public.
Filing complaints in consumer commissions on behalf of consumers.

answer.en: Testing products, publishing periodicals and filing complaints on behalf of consumers.
